newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific, CorTrak form alliance.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific, CorTrak form alliance.

text.p: CorTrak Medical Inc, a manufacturer of drug delivery systems, said Monday it formed an alliance with Boston Scientific Corp relating to CorTrak's coronary iontophoresis drug products.
As part of the alliance, Boston Scientific will distribute CorTrak's products internationally on an exclusive basis.

CorTrak's iontophoresis technology uses a catheter and an electronic field to transport drugs through difficult tissue barriers and into the cells where therapy is needed more quickly and deeply than conventional drug delivery systems.
